title: GBRG Semantic Cell
description: A node in the Governed Blast-Radius Graph. Its `kind` selects the shape: the four CODE kinds (function/class/import/module) carry the code-cell field set; `pattern` is a non-code regex cell from the estate REGEX corpus (prophet-core-catalog ds.regex-operational-dataset) carrying the corpus projection. See docs/ADR-002-pattern-cells.md.
$comment: `kind` is the discriminator. A cell validates against EXACTLY ONE of $defs/codeCell or $defs/patternCell — their required sets and closed property sets (additionalProperties:false, scoped per branch) are disjoint, so oneOf resolves unambiguously.

codeCell.title: GBRG code SemanticCell
codeCell.description: One unit of code (function/class/import/module) — the original GBRG cell shape. Unchanged.

cell_id.description: Stable code IRI, e.g. code://rust/src/lib.rs#foo. Deterministically hashed to a graphdb NodeId (u64) = first 8 bytes of sha256(cell_id), big-endian.

ast_hash.description: sha256 hex of the cell's AST/source slice.

generated.$comment: True if this cell is machine-generated (codegen). This is INDEPENDENT of the ProofArtifact epistemicLevel 'synthetic', which means synthetic DATA, never auto-generated code. See blast-radius-proof-artifact.schema.json and docs/ADR-001.

patternCell.title: GBRG pattern SemanticCell
patternCell.description: A non-code cell standing for one distinct regex from the estate REGEX corpus (prophet-core-catalog ds.regex-operational-dataset). Fields are the corpus projection, NOT the code-cell set. Code-file cells depend on it via `imports`-kind edges (graph-edge.schema.json); a pattern node's in-degree over those edges is `use_count` = its blast radius. See docs/ADR-002-pattern-cells.md.

record_type.$comment: Optional dataset line-type discriminator (gbrg-blast-radius.jsonl multiplexes SemanticCell and GraphEdge lines). Allowed so raw dataset records validate as-is; absent on a cell handed in on its own.

cell_id.description: Pattern IRI: rx://rx-<sha1[0:10] of the raw pattern>. The rx-<sha1[0:10]> fragment is the corpus record id (content hash: same regex across N repos collapses to ONE node). Deterministically hashed to a graphdb NodeId like any cell_id.

intent.$comment: One-line description of what the pattern matches. Seed field; may be empty ('') pending curation.

use_count.description: Total usage sites (in-degree over `imports` edges) = the pattern node's blast radius.

redos_suspect.$comment: True when the pattern has a catastrophic-backtracking shape (nested/alternation-under-quantifier). See the dataset SCHEMA.md rubric.
